question: Who was the first captain of India Hockey Team in Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaipal Singh Munda.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jaipal Singh Munda **was the **first captain **of **India Hockey Team** in **Olympics.**
 
• He led the Indian team in the **1928 Amsterdam Olympics **where they won their **first Olympic gold medal.**
 
• Jaipal Singh Munda was a prominent **Indian freedom fighter and politician** who also played a crucial role in the development of Indian hockey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishan Lal **was an** Indian hockey player** who played in the** 1956, 1960 and 1964 Olympics.** 

 
 
• He was known for his** exceptional goal-scoring ability.**
 
 
 
• **Dhyan Chand** was one of the** greatest hockey players** of all time. 
 
 
• He played for India in the **1928, 1932 and 1936 Olympics** and won **three Olympic gold medals.** 
 
• He was known for his incredible skills and is often referred to as the **'wizard of hockey'.**
